instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium close-up. On a winter street, the woman in the red puffer jacket (R1) stands on the left, holding a red smartphone with both hands and smiling down at the screen. Leaning in close on the right, the woman in the light gray puffer jacket (R2) looks at the screen with a warm smile. They stand shoulder-to-shoulder, sharing a cheerful moment over the phone. Bright daylight and soft backlighting highlight their happy expressions against a soft, blurred background.
